results.title: Why petrol and diesel are costlier in Himachal Pradesh from today
results.description: Petrol and diesel have become slightly costlier in Himachal Pradesh after the state imposed a 60 paise per litre Widow and Orphan Cess. The levy, effective from August 11, will fund welfare measures for widows and orphaned children.
